gold_row.question: What voltage did sensor 7.0 measure on 2004-03-01 at 03:35:16?
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 7})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-03-01T03:35:16"

ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
